}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== *"Model: ADM41L1 VER: 1.3" and "P/N: 08-06ADM4113" are silkscreened on the board. {{See also|Synology DiskStation Devices|List of NAS Devices}}
*This is a 4-bay NAS. It would appear to have 2x USB 2.0 ports.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Marvell]] 88F6282 @1.6GHz (''Armada 300'') *Memory: 256MB (DDR3) SDRAM ([[SK hynix]]) *Storage: 4MB (SPI NOR) Flash, :4x SATA ports, 1x eSATA port *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet port *USB: 2x USB 2.0 ports *Power: 12V, 3A via barrel
